newsitem.title: USA: Read-Rite sets shareholders rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Read-Rite sets shareholders rights plan.

text.p: Read-Rite Corp said Tuesday it had adopted a shareholder rights plan designed to act as a poison pill to combat an unsolicited takeover offer from Applied Magnetics Corp.
Read-Rite, which rejected the takeover offer Monday, said its board had approved a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right on each outstanding share of the company's common stock.

"The rights are designed to protect and maximize the long-term value of the company for our shareholders by assuring that they receive fair and equal treatment in any unsolicited proposed takeover of the company," said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Cyril Yansouni.
Each right entitles the holder to buy 0.001 share of the company's Series A participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $150.
The rights come into effect 10 days after a person or group acquires 20 percent or more of the company's common stock or starts a tender offer for 20 percent or more of the company.
Applied Magnetics had offered 0.679 Applied share for each Read-Rite share.
